battle.name: 龍門之戰
battle.brief: 大業十一年（615）四月，詔以衛尉少卿李淵為山西、河東撫慰大使，承製黶陟選補郡縣文武官，發河東兵討捕群盜。李淵行至龍門，擊賤帥母端兒破之，龍門至絳州一線重歸官軍。卡面的斯巴達長矛屬希臘重裝步兵方陣，與此役相隔一千四百餘年；隋軍近身用長矛、馬槊與環首刀，以弓弩掩護騎兵。

kit.name: 斯巴達長矛
kit.history: 兩米長的木槍，槍尾帶銅套。方陣裡它比劍更早決定誰站得住。

countries: 交戰一方是隋朝官軍，兵源與指揮系統都在河東就地生成：山西、河東撫慰大使李淵奉詔時兼著討捕使的權柄，可以承製黶陟、選補郡縣文武官，並發河東兵。所發之兵以郡兵、鄉兵與屯田戍卒為主，州縣長史、縣令各自徵發本地丁壯，農隙操練，遇警則集結為軍，兵器甲仗則取給於郡縣武庫，糧秣靠屯田與州縣轉運。另一方是河東、絳州一帶的群盜與叛眾，領頭者是被本紀稱為「賤帥」的母端兒，據龍門、絳州及汾水兩岸的村塢與山寨，依山傍水自守，多無常備編制，只推首領行事，備刀矛勁弓與簡陋的雲梯、檑木，能守村塢而攻城能力有限，專於截道、斷糧、劫掠。同一條戰線上還有十數股並起的賊勢：王須拔自稱漫天王、國號燕，魏刀兒自稱歷山飛，張起緒起於淮南眾至三萬，李子通渡淮自稱楚王，魏騏驎、敬盤陀、柴保昌、顏宣政、楊仲緒、朱粲各據一隅，其中朱粲甚至僭稱楚帝。北方更有突厥控弦之士窺伺塞北，官軍、地方叛眾與外患三方纏在河東一隅。
countriesEn: The Sui fielded its own order of battle, and both the troops and the command system were generated locally in Hedong. Li Yuan was appointed Inspector-Commissioner for Shanxi and Hedong with the additional powers of a commander charged with suppressing bandits: he could confirm, remove and replace the civil and military officials of the prefectures and counties, and he mustered the troops of Hedong. Those troops were the prefectural and county levies, the household militia and the garrison and farming soldiers; the district officials and county magistrates raised the local men themselves, men who drilled in the slack season and mustered into a force when word of trouble came, and their weapons and armour came from the county arsenals while grain came from the military farms and the county granaries. Against them stood the bandits and rebels of Hedong and the district of Jiangzhou, led by a chief the annals contemptuously style a vile commander, Mou Duan'er, who held the villages, stockades and mountain strongholds along the Fen River and the road to Longmen. Their following was no regular army: they obeyed one leader, dug themselves in behind village walls and trees, and carried sabres, spears, strong bows and crude scaling ladders and battering beams; they were poor at taking walled towns but adept at cutting the roads, severing grain convoys and plundering. The same front was crowded with a dozen other risings: Wang Xu-ba proclaimed himself the King of Man and set up the state of Yan, Wei Dao'er proclaimed himself the Flying One of Li Shan, Zhang Qixu rose in Huainan with some thirty thousand men, Li Zi-tong crossed the Huai and called himself King of Chu, while Wei Qi-lin, Jing Pan-tuo, Chai Bao-chang, Yan Xuan-zheng, Yang Zhong-ji and Zhu Zang each held a corner of the realm, Zhu Zang even assuming the title of Emperor of Chu. To the north, Turkic riders watched the frontier, so Hedong lay caught at once between the Sui army, the rebels and an outside enemy.
people: 主導者是李淵。時任衛尉少卿，此前代為弘化郡留守，關右十三郡的兵都受他徵發，《資治通鑑》稱他御眾寬簡、人多附之；隋煬帝卻因他相貌奇異、又與圖讖相應而忌他，所以這次出鎮既是用他，也防著他。掌隋廷者是隋煬帝楊廣，其時避暑汾陽宮，四月下詔遣撫慰大使討捕群盜；同年七月，他自塞北遇突厥始畢可汗率騎數十萬逼近乘輿，車駕避入雁門。起義一方的主角是母端兒，這位「賤帥」是本紀唯一留下姓名的龍門首領，傳中不載其家世來歷，只記其據地與被破的結局。地方上還有大批被捲入的百姓與吏員：郡縣守令有的望風奔竄，有的棄城而去，叛眾則多是被官軍過度處置逼反的流民，與母端兒聚在龍門、絳州一帶。值得記一筆的是李淵次子世民年方十六，同年應募隸屯衛將軍雲定興，以白晝引旌旗數十里、夜間鉦鼓相應的疑兵之計，助雁門解圍，父子二人在大業十一年都已身處亂局之中。
peopleEn: The man in command was Li Yuan. He then held the post of Captain of the Court of Military Affairs, and before this had served as acting Commandant of Honghua prefecture, with the troops of the thirteen commanderies of Guanyou mustered under him; the Zizhi Tongjian says that he ruled his men with ease and simplicity and that men flocked to him. The Sui emperor Yang Guang, however, was jealous of him, both for his unusual appearance and for the way his name matched the prophecies in the auspicious charts, so this appointment used Li Yuan while also keeping a watch on him. At the top of the Sui court was Emperor Yang himself, who was then spending the summer at Fenyang Palace; in the fourth month he issued the order that sent an Inspector-Commissioner out against the bandits, and in the seventh month of the same year, while he was on the northern frontier, the Turkic khan Qimin Chi led tens of thousands of riders against his convoy and the imperial carriage fled into Yanmen. On the rebel side the principal figure was Mou Duan'er, the vile commander who is the only leader of the Longmen rising whose name the annals preserve; his family and origins are not recorded, only the ground he held and the manner of his defeat. On the ground there were also great numbers of commoners and officials caught up in the affair: some magistrates and county officers fled at the first word, others abandoned their cities, and much of the rebel following consisted of displaced villagers driven into revolt by over-harsh treatment, gathered around Mou Duan'er along the Longmen and Jiangzhou roads. It is worth noting that Li Yuan's second son, Shimin, was only sixteen that year; he enlisted under the general Yun Dingxing and helped relieve Yanmen by the stratagem of trailing banners and standards for tens of li by day and beating gongs and drums by night. Father and son were both already inside the disorder of the eleventh year of Daye.
kits: 卡面這件斯巴達長矛是希臘人的兩米木槍，槍尾帶銅套，用在重裝步兵的密集方陣裡，負責撐住前排、替後列的劍士擋開衝撞，在方陣的推進與接戰中起決定作用。但這件兵器與大業十一年的河東全無涉係，中原既無斯巴達，也沒有重裝方陣，史料中找不到它出現的痕跡。此役隋軍真正上手的是另一套東西：近身是長矛與馬槊，隋軍步騎所用的槊比希臘長矛更長、兩端可施刀刃，更利於對付騎兵；佩刀是環首刀與直刃橫刀，軍人常備環首刀、帶刀與小刀；弓弩是野戰主力，蹶張弩與臂張弩用於射手戰，連弩則列於城頭與關隘；攻城有撞車、井車與飛樓，防守有拒馬、鹿角與陷坑。除兵器之外，還有帳幕、旌旗、鼓角、皮甲與兜鍪這些維持軍隊的什物，糧秣靠屯田與州縣轉運，戰馬與牛車負責運載，黃河與汾水的舟船是河東一線最方便的輸送工具。
kitsEn: The Spartan dory on the card face is a wooden spear two metres long with a bronze shoe at its butt end, used in the dense phalanx of the Greek heavy infantry, where its job was to hold the front rank steady and to shield the sword-bearers behind it from the shock of impact; in the advance and the clash of the phalanx it was the weapon that decided who kept his footing. This weapon, however, has no connection whatever with Hedong in the eleventh year of Daye: there was no Sparta in the Chinese plain and no phalanx either, and no trace of it appears in the records. What the Sui troops actually carried was a different set of things. At close quarters they had long spears and mao-sha, the mao-sha being longer than the Greek dory and edged at both ends, which made it better suited to meeting cavalry. For cutting they had ring-pommel sabres and straight-bladed swords, and the common soldier carried a ring-pommel sabre, a dao and a small knife. Bows and crossbows were the backbone of the field army, with the strong-armed and the drawing crossbow used in shooting lines and the repeating crossbow posted on walls and passes. For attack they had battering rams, well-carts and flying towers; for defence, caltrops, spiked barriers and pits dug inside the gates. Beyond the weapons themselves there were the camp gear, banners, drums and gongs, leather armour and helmets that kept the army together; grain came from the military farms and the county transport system, warhorses and ox carts carried it, and on the Yellow River and the Fen the boats were the most convenient means of moving supplies along the Hedong line.
tactics: 史書只說「破之」兩字，未詳布陣之法；就隋代河東的兵制與龍門一帶的地形推想，大致是撫在先、剿在後，剿以突進破點、撫以收編穩定。李淵出晉陽，沿汾水谷地南下，行至龍門便攻母端兒。龍門在絳州黃河東岸，禹門渡口扼住河東通往關中的咽喉，河道狹窄、兩岸山壁逼仄，大隊人馬難以展開，正是騎兵縱馳受限、而步卒持槊列陣可以站穩的地形，官軍於是以步兵居前、槊矛成列，騎兵在兩翼與背後掩護，逼近其村塢即攻破之，再分道追掃、斷其糧道、驅入山澤，凡來降者即收編入郡兵與屯田，不加殺戮。與此同時，關中樊子蓋討絳賊敬盤陀的處置恰恰相反：不分臮否，自汾水以北把村塢盡焚、降者即坑，結果百姓怨憤，叛眾愈聚愈多。李淵用招撫換得河東的暫時安寧，樊子蓋用焚殺把河東推向失控；同一條線上兩種手段的對照，才是這場龍門之戰真正的內涵。
tacticsEn: The annals record only the two words 'defeated him' and give no account of the deployment; judged from the military system of Sui Hedong and from the ground around Longmen, the pattern was pacification first and destruction second, destruction by a sudden stroke against a point, pacification by the absorption of the broken. Li Yuan marched out from Jinyang down the valley of the Fen and struck at Mou Duan'er when he reached Longmen. Longmen stands on the east bank of the Yellow River in the district of Jiangzhou, and the Yumen crossing commands the throat of the road from Hedong to Guanzhong; the channel is narrow and the rock walls press in on either side, so that a massed army cannot deploy and cavalry cannot gallop freely, which is exactly the ground on which infantry holding a line of spears can stand firm. The Sui accordingly put foot in front with spears and lances ranked, cavalry on the wings and in the rear, and once they had closed on the stockades they broke them, then swept in several columns, cut the grain road, and drove the survivors into the hills; all who came in were taken into the county levies and the farms rather than killed. Set against this was the conduct of Fan Zi-gai in Guanzhong, who was sent with troops from the west against the Jiangzhou bandit Jing Pan-tuo: without sorting the guilty from the innocent, he burned every stockade north of the Fen and put those who surrendered to death, and the people, angered, came together as bandits in ever greater numbers. Li Yuan bought a temporary quiet in Hedong by taking in the surrendered; Fan Zi-gai drove Hedong out of control by burning and killing. The contrast between the two methods on the same front is the real content of the battle of Longmen.
data: 可查證的硬數字不多，先列與本役同年、同區的記載：大業十一年四月，李淵以撫慰大使發河東兵討捕群盜，行至龍門擊賤帥母端兒破之——這一戰本身的雙方兵力、交戰時辰、斬獲與損耗，《隋書》與《資治通鑑》都沒有留下數字，可確證的只有「破之」二字。同一年的其他記載可作尺度：七月雁門之圍，突厥始畢可汗率騎數十萬逼近乘輿，齊王暕保崞縣，城中兵民十五萬口而食僅可支二旬，一度克城四十一而得三十九；樊子蓋奉詔發關中兵數萬討絳賊敬盤陀，經年不能剋；王須拔、魏刀兒各收眾十餘萬，張起緒起於淮南眾至三萬；十二月李淵代樊子蓋討絳賊，改行招撫，先後降者數萬人，餘黨散入它郡。地理尺度上，晉陽至絳州龍門沿汾水谷地南下約數百里，龍門本身是黃河禹門渡口，河道狹長，一次縱隊行軍與糧車輸送都受限制。
dataEn: There are few hard figures, and those that exist belong to the same year and the same region. In the fourth month of the eleventh year of Daye Li Yuan, as Inspector-Commissioner, mustered the troops of Hedong against the bandits, reached Longmen and defeated the vile commander Mou Duan'er; of the opposing numbers, the hour of the engagement, the captures and the losses, neither the Sui Shu nor the Zizhi Tongjian preserves a single figure, and the only certainty is the word 'defeated'. Other records of the same year serve as a scale: at the siege of Yanmen in the seventh month the Turkic khan Qimin Chi led tens of thousands of riders against the imperial convoy, the Prince of Qi Yang Wei held Wutai, and the city held a hundred and fifty thousand soldiers and civilians with food for no more than twenty days, and at one point forty-one towns were taken and thirty-nine of them held; Fan Zi-gai was sent with several tens of thousands of men from Guanzhong against Jing Pan-tuo and could not take him for a year; Wang Xu-ba and Wei Dao'er each gathered more than a hundred thousand followers and Zhang Qixu rose in Huainan with some thirty thousand; in the twelfth month Li Yuan replaced Fan Zi-gai against the Jiangzhou bandits, changed the policy to taking men in, and several tens of thousands came down, the remnants scattering into other prefectures. On the scale of distance, the march from Jinyang to Longmen at Jiangzhou ran some several hundred li down the valley of the Fen, and Longmen itself was the Yumen crossing of the Yellow River, where the channel is long and narrow, so that a column on the march and the grain carts were both constrained.
cause: 打起來的原因有三層。最外一層是隋朝的兵制崩了：自大業年間三征高句麗，天下丁壯盡數徵發，府庫耗盡，役繁民困，州縣的郡兵與屯田不是缺人就是缺糧，鄉里只剩老弱，一旦有變，官府無兵可調。第二層是亂源同時四起：大業十一年前後，王須拔、魏刀兒、張起緒、李子通、魏騏驎、敬盤陀、柴保昌、顏宣政、楊仲緒、朱粲各自起兵，河北、山東、淮南、關中、河東同時燃起，隋朝的地方秩序整片崩塌，朝廷只能靠派出大員逐處收拾。第三層才是本役的直接起因：隋煬帝北巡塞外、避暑汾陽宮，河東是汾水與黃河間的漕運與驛道要衝，群盜踞村塢截道，文書與漕糧不能暢行，龍門又是通往關中的咽喉，於是下詔以撫慰大使兼討捕使出師，先以官職與糧秣安其民、收其眾，同時以河東兵討捕群盜；龍門一線的母端兒，正是這道詔書要掃掉的頭一個目標。
causeEn: There were three layers of cause. The outermost was the collapse of the Sui military system: after the three campaigns against Goguryeo in the Daye years, the men of the empire had all been taken into service, the treasuries were emptied, the corvees multiplied and the people exhausted; the prefectural armies and the military farms of the counties were short of men or short of grain, the villages held nothing but the old and the weak, and once a disturbance began the government had no soldiers to send. The second layer was that the sources of disorder had risen everywhere at once: around the eleventh year of Daye Wang Xu-ba, Wei Dao'er, Zhang Qixu, Li Zi-tong, Wei Qi-lin, Jing Pan-tuo, Chai Bao-chang, Yan Xuan-zheng, Yang Zhong-ji and Zhu Zang each raised a rebellion, and Hebei, Shandong, Huainan, Guanzhong and Hedong all caught fire at the same time, so that the local order of the Sui collapsed across the board and the court could only send out great officers to pick up the pieces one place at a time. The third layer was the immediate occasion of this engagement. The emperor had gone north of the frontier and was spending the summer at Fenyang Palace; Hedong was the artery of transport and post road between the Fen and the Yellow River, the bandits sitting in their stockades on the road, so that documents and grain convoys could not pass, and Longmen was the throat of the road to Guanzhong. The order therefore went out to appoint an Inspector-Commissioner who was also a commander against bandits, to pacify the people with offices and grain and to take them in, and at the same time to send the troops of Hedong against the bandits. Mou Duan'er on the Longmen road was the first target this order meant to sweep away.
impact: 就當時而言，這一戰的意義不在戰果而在權柄。李淵以撫慰大使兼討捕使出鎮河東，握著發兵、選補官吏、黶陟官吏與籌措糧秣的實權；龍門一役破賊之後，他能夠在同一套體制之內用「有降者即收編」的辦法吸納數萬降眾，把流民變成郡兵與屯田戶，到同年十二月詔命他代樊子蓋討絳賊、改焚殺為招撫，河東的戰線就這樣由亂轉平。表面看是一次邊緣地帶的平亂，實際上等於讓此後受封唐國公的李淵在隋朝的官制之內合法地握住了河東的兵源、馬匹、糧秣與官吏任免，這正是兩年後起兵時最現成的本錢。往後看，龍門仍是河東與關中之間的關鍵渡口，這一帶的通道、渡口與屯田，在唐初的經營中一再被提起。必須說明的是，關於此役在正史中的直接記載只有《隋書·煬帝紀》大業十一年四月那一句，後人對其戰術細節與戰果規模的推斷多屬揣測，可以確證的只是破賊這一結果本身。
impactEn: For the time, the meaning of this battle lay less in the fighting than in the powers it placed in one pair of hands. Li Yuan went out to Hedong as Inspector-Commissioner and commander against bandits, holding the real authority to raise troops, to appoint and remove officials, to grade and promote them and to procure grain; after the victory at Longmen he was able, within that very system, to absorb tens of thousands of surrendered men by the method of taking in all who came down, turning displaced villagers into county levies and farm households, and when in the twelfth month the order came for him to replace Fan Zi-gai against the Jiangzhou bandits and to substitute taking men in for burning them, the front in Hedong was turned from disorder to order in this way. On the surface this was the pacification of a marginal district; in substance it allowed Li Yuan, who would later hold the title Duke of Tang, to grip lawfully, within the institutions of the Sui, the soldiers, the horses, the grain and the appointments of Hedong, and that was the readiest capital he had when he rose two years later. Looking further ahead, Longmen remained the key crossing between Hedong and Guanzhong, and the roads, ferries and farms of that district were raised again and again in the early Tang. It should be said that the direct record of this engagement in the official histories is a single sentence in the eleventh year of Daye, fourth month, of the Sui Shu; the reconstructions of its tactical detail and the scale of its results are for the most part conjecture, and what can be affirmed is only the result itself, the breaking of the bandits.
result: 結果有明文可稽：四月，李淵行至龍門，擊賤帥母端兒，破之。母端兒一夥的村塢與山寨被攻破，其眾或潰散、或歸降、或散入山澤，龍門至絳州一線重歸官軍控制，河東的漕道與驛傳得以恢復；接下來是李淵繼續在河東分道討捕群盜，到十二月奉詔代樊子蓋討絳賊敬盤陀，把焚殺改成招撫，賊眾因此多降，前後數萬人，餘黨散入它郡，汾晉之間的戰事至此收束，李淵也以功加賞、權柄愈重。但亂源並未因此清除：同年七月有雁門之圍，突厥數十萬騎兵逼近乘輿，隋廷靠各郡援軍與義成公主事先報信才解圍；兩年後（617）劉武周自馬邑起兵，眾至數十萬，突厥立其為定楊可汗，軍鋒破樓煩、取汾陽宮、進圍雁門，晉陽危殆，李淵終於以太原留守起兵，山西的亂局才由剿撫換成另一種解決方式。這場龍門之戰，於是成了隋末唐初交接線上的一段前奏，而不是一場可以獨立講完的戰爭。
resultEn: The result is plainly on record: in the fourth month Li Yuan reached Longmen, struck the vile commander Mou Duan'er and defeated him. The villages and stockades of Mou Duan'er's band were broken, and his following broke up, surrendered or scattered into the hills; the line from Longmen to Jiangzhou returned to the control of the government troops, and the grain road and the post road of Hedong could move again. What followed was Li Yuan continuing to sweep the bandits of Hedong in several columns; in the twelfth month he was ordered to replace Fan Zi-gai against the Jiangzhou bandit Jing Pan-tuo, he changed the burning and killing to taking men in, and large numbers came down, several tens of thousands in all, the remnants scattering into other prefectures, and the fighting between the Fen and the Jin came to an end, Li Yuan receiving reward and added authority. But the source of the disorder was not removed: in the seventh month of the same year came the siege of Yanmen, tens of thousands of Turkic riders closing on the imperial convoy, and the court was released only when the armies of the prefectures arrived and Princess Yicheng had sent word in advance; two years later, in 617, Liu Wuzhou rose at Mayi with tens of thousands of followers, the Turks made him Prince of Dingyang, his columns broke Loulan, took Fenyang Palace and closed on Yanmen, and Jinyang itself was in danger, until Li Yuan finally rose as the Commandant of Taiyuan. The disorder in Shanxi was only then settled by a means other than pacification and destruction, and the battle of Longmen stands as a prelude on the line where the late Sui handed over to the early Tang, not as a war that can be told on its own.
